entities.summary: Jan Ludvig is a Czech former professional ice hockey forward. He played in the National Hockey League with the New Jersey Devils and Buffalo Sabres. His son, John Ludvig, also plays professional ice hockey. He has two other sons, Jake and Mick, and two daughters, Dasha and Katie.
